summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Vereinsmitglieder Management App. Backend APIs working well, frontend navigation and authentication functional. One critical backend issue identified with payment table display.

critical_bugs.issue: Returns empty array instead of member payment data, causing dashboard table to show 'No members' despite members existing
critical_bugs.impact: Dashboard payment table not displaying members, blocking core functionality
critical_bugs.details: Member creation works, member count updates correctly, but payment table remains empty. Debug endpoint with same logic works perfectly. Possible caching or routing conflict.

integration_issues.issue: Member table shows 'No members available' even after successful member creation

passed_tests: Public page loads and displays correctly
Login page displays Google login button
Dashboard authentication works with session cookies
Member count updates correctly in dashboard stats
Add member dialog opens and form submission works
Navigation between pages (public, login, dashboard) works
Google login button is present and clickable
Public member endpoint returns correct data structure
All CRUD operations for members work via API
Payment update operations work via API
User authentication and session management works
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Fix /api/payments/year/{year} endpoint - it returns empty array instead of member payment data. This prevents the dashboard from displaying members in the payment table. The endpoint logic appears correct (debug endpoint with same code works), suggesting a routing conflict or caching issue. All other functionality works perfectly.
